categories.main_business_segments: Shinkong Textile Co., Ltd. operates primarily in textile manufacturing, including weaving, dyeing, finishing, and garment production. The company also engages in retail of apparel and accessories, leasing income from real estate, and other related businesses such as wholesale and retail of daily necessities and cosmetics. Its business is divided mainly into textile products (61%), retail/garments (30%), and leasing income (9%).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced textile technologies including yarn-dyed woven and knitted fabrics, piece-dyed fabrics, and digital printing. It applies various finishing processes such as moisture-wicking, durable water repellency, antibacterial treatment, lamination, coating, and calendaring to enhance product functionality. Innovations include elastic reflective yarn weaving, thermoplastic polyester elastomer (TPEE) for recyclable elastic fabrics, and industrial high-strength polyester fibers for durable apparel. The company emphasizes sustainable production with certifications like ISO 14001, bluesign, GRS, OCS, and RWS.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Shinkong Textile serves international well-known apparel brands primarily in the US and Europe, with expanding markets in Asia. Its retail division represents domestic consumers through brands like PGA TOUR and Adidas Golf, as well as proprietary fashion brands. The company also supplies group uniforms to corporate and institutional clients. The textile products cater to outdoor sportswear, functional sports textiles, fashion apparel, industrial and medical textiles, and composite functional materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Taoyuan. It exports extensively to the United States, Europe, and Asia. Plans include establishing an overseas subsidiary in Indonesia to diversify production risks and expand capacity. The retail business focuses on the domestic Taiwanese market, while the export business targets global markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shinkong Textile operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the textile supply chain, focusing on fabric weaving, dyeing, finishing, garment manufacturing, and retail. It sources raw materials domestically and internationally and provides value-added textile products to brand customers. The company also engages in real estate leasing as a supplementary business.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes sustainable development and ESG integration, focusing on developing eco-friendly and functional textiles using recycled and bio-based materials. R&D efforts target multi-functional and sustainable fabrics, digital and smart manufacturing, and circular economy initiatives like the Infinity Shirt Project for closed-loop recycling. It also emphasizes talent development, supply chain compliance, and digital transformation to enhance operational efficiency and market responsiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of textile fabrics and garments, both for export and domestic retail. Additional income streams include leasing real estate properties and providing group uniform design and manufacturing services. The company also benefits from dividends and financial investments related to its subsidiaries and affiliates.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shinkong Textile competes with major textile manufacturers in China, the EU, the US, and India. It positions itself as a leader in functional and sustainable textiles with strong R&D capabilities and a diversified product portfolio. The company leverages Taiwan's strong synthetic fiber production and focuses on innovation and ESG compliance to differentiate from competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$4.21 billion in the latest fiscal year, representing a 24.58% increase from the prior year. Net profit attributable to owners was NT$869 million, up 33.91%. Total assets reached NT$21.53 billion, growing 16.10%, with equity increasing by 17.91%. The company shows a stable growth trajectory supported by expanding export orders and domestic retail gains.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shinkong Textile emphasizes high-quality, innovative, and sustainable textile products that combine multi-functionality with environmental responsibility. Its unique value lies in integrating eco-friendly recycled materials, advanced fabric technologies, and closed-loop recycling systems to meet global brand demands for sustainability and performance. The company also offers diversified product lines tailored to outdoor, sports, medical, and industrial applications, supported by strong R&D and supply chain management.
